parameters.query: SELECT last_snapshot, last_fingerprints, overall_status FROM automation_self_health_meta WHERE id = 1;

={{(() => { const esc=(v)=>String(v??'').replace(/'/g,"''"); const nul=(v)=>(v===null||v===undefined||v==='')?'NULL':`'${esc(v)}'`; const nulN=(v)=>(v===null||v===undefined||v==='')?'NULL':String(Number(v)); const details=JSON.stringify($json.details||{}).replace(/'/g,"''"); return `INSERT INTO automation_self_health_state (checked_at, workflow_id, workflow_name, expected_state, actual_state, last_execution_at, last_execution_status, expected_interval_seconds, overdue, consecutive_failures, health_status, reason, fingerprint, details) VALUES ('${esc($json.checked_at)}'::timestamptz, ${nul($json.workflow_id)}, '${esc($json.workflow_name)}', '${esc($json.expected_state)}', ${nul($json.actual_state)}, ${$json.last_execution_at ? `'${esc($json.last_execution_at)}'::timestamptz` : 'NULL'}, ${nul($json.last_execution_status)}, ${nulN($json.expected_interval_seconds)}, ${$json.overdue ? 'TRUE' : 'FALSE'}, ${Number($json.consecutive_failures||0)}, '${esc($json.health_status)}', ${nul($json.reason)}, ${nul($json.fingerprint)}, '${details}'::jsonb);`; })()}}

={{(() => { const esc=(v)=>String(v??'').replace(/'/g,"''"); const snap=JSON.stringify($json.last_snapshot||{}).replace(/'/g,"''"); const fps=JSON.stringify($json.last_fingerprints||{}).replace(/'/g,"''"); return `UPDATE automation_self_health_meta SET last_snapshot='${snap}'::jsonb, last_fingerprints='${fps}'::jsonb, overall_status='${esc($json.overall_status)}', updated_at=now() WHERE id=1;`; })()}}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ source: $json.source, severity: $json.severity, component: $json.component, event: $json.event, status: $json.status, timestamp: $json.timestamp, message: $json.message, details: $json.details, requires_attention: $json.requires_attention, suggested_action: $json.suggested_action }) }}
